Use the exact retained binaries/CSS described in the assessment. Six absolute

One acquisition proves the bounded task in eight cells:88 checks,86 passing and

The150ms negative window is shorter than the750ms positive deadline; do not claim

No further acquisition is part of this batch. Any new target/runtime or mutation
